# Wait on Occurrence

![Wait on Occurrence function icon](../../../../assets/function-icons/functions/synchronization/occurrences/wait.svg)

[Synchronization functions](../index.md) · [All functions](../../index.md)

Suspends this execution path until an eligible signal arrives or the wait expires. An invalid reference returns timed out immediately. Timeout is signed I32 milliseconds: -1 (default) waits indefinitely, 0 checks immediately, positive values set a monotonic deadline; values below -1 are controlled argument faults. ignore previous defaults to TRUE and ignores signals before atomic registration. FALSE accepts an unseen earlier generation for this Wait instance; acknowledged signals are not replayed and multiple signals may coalesce. This is not a FIFO. Cancellation does not publish a normal timed out result.

Suspends only this activation until an eligible signal or monotonic deadline. Timeout defaults to I32(-1), ignore previous to TRUE. Zero checks immediately; an invalid reference returns TRUE immediately. FALSE observes unseen generations per Wait instance without a FIFO or global signal consumption. Values below -1 are controlled argument faults. An unused result does not eliminate the wait.

## Types and connection rules

Fixed nominal Occurrence reference without payload. Queue, Notifier, Semaphore, Rendezvous, widget references and scalar data do not coerce to Occurrence.

- Type resolution: `fixed`; result expression: `declared_output_type`.
- Implicit coercion: not enabled by this resolver; individual port policies remain explicit.
- Arrays: not accepted; lifting policy: `none`.

No implicit array lifting or payload parameter. Explicit reference transport preserves identity without creating a resource.

**Input count:** 3; this contract does not enable variadic inputs.

Port order: `timeout_ms` → `occurrence` → `ignore_previous`.
